fees.body: Donorfit takes nothing from the donations you raise. There is no Donorfit platform fee and no Donorfit transaction fee, so more of every gift stays with your cause.

platform.label: Platform fee
platform.text: No monthly platform fee for using Donorfit.

transaction.label: Transaction fee
transaction.text: Donorfit deducts nothing from each donation or payment.

fees.providerNote: Payment providers such as Stripe, PayPal or GoCardless charge their own processing fees, which may still apply. These are set by the provider you connect, not by Donorfit, and donors can choose to cover them.
fees.addonNote: {{product}} is an add-on module with its own price. The 0% applies to the donations and payments you collect with it.
fees.headline: Keep more of every donation

donor.title: Donor gives
donor.text: A one-off or recurring donation through your form.

donorfit.title: Donorfit
donorfit.text: No platform fee and no transaction fee.

provider.title: Payment provider
provider.text: Charges its own processing fee, unless the donor covers it.

org.title: Your organisation receives
org.text: The donation, minus any provider fee.
